status_at_freeze: unscored reranking alternatives; previous retrieval scores exposed

selection.regression_gates: No new evidence losses and no aggregate source completeness regression on every source/split, including development. Failure stops this candidate; do not select another using regression scores.

strategy_details.rrf: sum 1/(60+route_rank), original retained route orders, same caps
strategy_details.rule-no-dual: subtract existing 0.1 dual bonus only; all other scores unchanged
strategy_details.rule-diverse: greedy 0.85*original rule score-0.15*max normalized body trigram Jaccard, same caps; no embeddings or gold labels
strategy_details.controls: single-route-first controls retain the whole pool with other route as tail; cap/length/top10 ablations are diagnosis only, never eligible for adoption

measurement.unit: 384 source-query pools x9 strategies =3456 offline selections; 304 unique question IDs across datasets, holdout repeated across2source configs
measurement.selection_only_latency: offline ranking/decision bookkeeping and text similarity, not API latency or reranker model inference; no production performance claim
measurement.scoring: original literal evidence with NFKC/whitespace normalization; positives macro-averaged; negatives separate; annotated evidence reciprocal rank, not exhaustive relevance MRR or full precision
measurement.reproduction: rebuild application, validate corpus/source hashes, reconstruct merge and compare exact pool and production selected objects before scoring any alternatives

boundaries: No retrieval, model, original text, permission, answer, or production config changes
All datasets exposed and synthetic, including the previous same-author source holdout; no independent acceptance claim
Only development selects a candidate; other splits are regression audits
No online ranker installed. Dedicated model comparison is a later experiment, not simulated with embeddings or a tiny chat model. No model/network invocation in this replay.
Frozen single parameter per method; no sweeps after scores. If no acceptable candidate, retain business rule.
